explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/740 (Erdős–Hajnal): if χ(G) = m is infinite and r ≥ 1, must G contain a subgraph with chromatic number m and no odd cycle of length ≤ r? The statement quantifies over G with infinite chromaticCardinal and all r (r = 0 is vacuous), asking for a Subgraph H with the same chromatic cardinal and NoShortOddCycle H r. Open per the page (only m = ℵ₀, r = 3 is known, by Rödl). Faithful.
